name: The Eternal King
source:
"May you live in interesting times." - The first of three ancient Chinese curses

Living in a small town has it's perks. There's no denying that. Kids can play outside past dark, if you forgot something at the grocery store, your neighbor is sure to have an extra, and the cost of living is as good as you could ask for. But, the cozy, small town lifestyle does come with one large caveat.

It's SO fucking BORING.

You have spent your entire life wishing for something different, something interesting. When, one seemingly boring night, she showed up. A hot, purple, demon girl who calls you her King and wants to give you superpowers!

Finally, for the first time in your life, you live in interesting times.

[From [URL=https://charmillian.itch.io/the-eternal-king]itch.io[/URL]]
